Planning to head out this Holy Week? Nothing beats a restful and hassle-free vacation with a well-planned itinerary. What’s more, the following Robinsons Malls will be at your service and help you prepare for your long-awaited Lenten trip.
Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Luisita, and Robinsons Tagaytay will operate on regular mall hours starting April 18, Maundy Thursday to April 19, Good Friday- perfect timing for pilgrims and families heading out of town.
Likewise, more Robinsons Malls will be open on regular mall hours on Maundy Thursday. Make sure to include the following malls in your itinerary: Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, and Robinsons Place Ilocos will be helpful for those planning to retreat north of Manila; Robinsons Place Dasmariñas and Robinsons Place General Trias will be go-to places for the Southerners; while Robinsons Place Naga and Robinsons Place Palawan will be ideal for families and friends who want to experience peace and quiet farther away from the busy metro.
The rest of Robinsons Malls located in Luzon shall resume operations on April 20, Black Saturday. #
